name: popscale-platform
description: Read public Popscale documentation and safely administer company-scoped interviews and learning journeys through separate remote MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Popscale interviews and safe journeys
interface.longDescription: Search the public, read-only Popscale Docs MCP or connect to the company-scoped Popscale Platform MCP to administer interview Studies, questions, invitations, evidence and analyses, or build validated learning journeys. Sensitive and publishing actions require the server's dedicated scopes and explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Search the public Popscale docs for how journeys work and cite the page status.
Create a safe Popscale journey from approved company knowledge and let me review it before publishing.
Show my interview Studies and help me edit one question safely.
